supabase-js 2.117.2 -- vendor/supabase.js
=========================================

The unmodified browser (UMD) build `dist/umd/supabase.js` of the npm package @supabase/supabase-js@2.117.2
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/@supabase/supabase-js/v/2.117.2, https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js).
Checked 2026-10-18: byte-identical to the file in the npm tarball.

The bundle contains these packages, all under the MIT License:
  @supabase/supabase-js, auth-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js, functions-js 2.117.2   Copyright (c) 2020 Supabase
  iceberg-js 0.8.1 (used by storage-js)                                                        Copyright (c) 2025 Supabase
  @supabase/phoenix 0.4.5 (Phoenix Channels JavaScript client, used by realtime-js)            Copyright (c) 2014 Chris McCord
and helpers from tslib 2.8.1 (Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation, 0BSD -- no notice required).
